## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) and VXX flagged NEUTRAL in the regime signals (VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY) — mixed ratio reads plus neutral HYG/LQD signal confirm an ambiguous market stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit/ liquidity reads muted: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION → HYG/LQD slight ↑ rising (credit stress easing). Volatility mixed: VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, signaling tactical caution despite longer-run calm.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION and IEF (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND → yields showing short-term jitter but no clear trend; dollar signals neutral per regime data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Commodities/cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials/semis strong via SOXX (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.62%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) — style: cyclical/resource bias over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US large caps soft short-term: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%), QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +1.69%); Emerging Markets outperforming: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%), China FXI in CORRECTION (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +3.53%) — EM leadership but China mixed.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: IBIT (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.73% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND; small caps confirming risk-on pockets via IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%). VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) rising tempers froth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND; base/industrial metals show longer-term strength but copper CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy constructive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%); natural gas weakness persists with UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) and broad commodity ETFs (SLV, XME) both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — SPY, QQQ, XLK show 1W negative vs 1M positive (multiple core ETFs) which suppresses conviction and signals a transitional market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to cyclical/resource ETFs showing strength (XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor tech (XLK CORRECTION); reduce exposure to areas with short-term weakness and maintain neutral stance on duration given mixed TLT/IEF reads.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy (XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND), Materials (XME (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology (XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION), Communication (sector breadth -3.79% 1W suggests pressure).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and Gold GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 as complacency pivot, HYG/LQD divergence (watch HYG ↑ vs LQD ↓ for credit tilt), SLV breakouts given current momentum, XLK/QQQ short-term breakdown risk if 1W weakness continues.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with cyclical/commodity ETFs leading while large-cap tech shows short-term weakness. Watch the MAJOR divergence (SPY/QQQ/XLK 1W negative vs 1M positive) and rising short-term VXX which could cap risk appetite.
